name: Saul
summary: A tall young man of the tribe of Benjamin, the king the LORD gave Israel when they asked for one. He disobeyed the LORD, grew jealous of David, and died in battle on Mount Gilboa.

key_moments.title: Anointed While Seeking Donkeys
key_moments.description: While searching for his father's lost donkeys, Saul came to Samuel, whom the LORD had told to expect him. Samuel poured oil on Saul's head and anointed him captain over the LORD's people.

key_moments.title: Rejected for Disobeying
key_moments.description: Saul spared King Agag and the best of the animals of Amalek, though the LORD had said to destroy them. Samuel told him that obeying the LORD matters more than sacrifice, and that the LORD had rejected him as king.

key_moments.title: Throws a Javelin at David
key_moments.description: The women sang that Saul had slain thousands but David ten thousands, and from that day Saul eyed David. An evil spirit came on Saul, and he threw a javelin at David twice.

key_moments.title: Consults the Woman at En-dor
key_moments.description: With the Philistines against him and no answer from God, Saul went in disguise to a woman with a familiar spirit at En-dor. Samuel appeared and told him he and his sons would die the next day.

key_moments.title: Falls on His Own Sword
key_moments.description: The Philistines killed his sons on Mount Gilboa, and archers badly wounded Saul. When his armourbearer would not kill him, Saul fell on his own sword.
